mentions.author: westondeboer
mentions.storyTitle: Using sophisticated software your iPhone can calculate your heart beat.

mentions.author: pstuart
mentions.text: Between Paul Ekman's work in behavioral science and detecting a persons pulse rate from video (http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONZcjs1Pjmk), it seems like one could have a pretty decent "lie detector" running on a smart phone.

mentions.author: pgeorgi
mentions.text: "read your heartrate" reminded me of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONZcjs1Pjmk (video to MIT paper submitted to SIGGRAPH about emphasizing video features, blood flow among them)

mentions.author: raverbashing
mentions.storyTitle: A New Algorithm Reveals the Hidden World of Imperceptible Motion
mentions.text: I remember a similar technique (maybe it's from the same people) where they amplified color changes. So the tiny flushes caused by the heartbeat were clearly visible https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONZcjs1Pjmk (from 1m30s)

mentions.author: CamperBob2
mentions.storyTitle: Subpixel: A subpixel convolutional neural network implementation with Tensorflow
mentions.text: Yes, and it's almost ridiculous how well that can work: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONZcjs1Pjmk

mentions.author: titojankowski
mentions.storyTitle: No one gives a fuck about Climate Change
mentions.text: Reminds me of those visualizations designed for magnifying tiny changes, Eulerian Video Magnification: https://youtu.be/ONZcjs1Pjmk Perhaps a potential application?

mentions.author: lowdest
mentions.storyTitle: User succumbs to a seizure in virtual reality while other players can only watch
mentions.text: >What can we hack together that can be used to filter seizures? I think a video filter could do this. See this video on Eulerian Video Amplification from SIGGRAPH 2012: https://youtu.be/ONZcjs1Pjmk A similar technique to reduce the amplitude of strobing seems plausible.

mentions.author: HPsquared
mentions.storyTitle: Technique for Manipulating Satellite Photos Now Reveals Ancient Images (2025)
mentions.text: See also: Eulerian Video Magnification (EVM) to amplify subtle motions and colour changes: https://youtu.be/ONZcjs1Pjmk https://youtu.be/_qtzWNZApsw
